title: Condensin loop extrusion properties, roadblocks, and role in homology search in S. cerevisiae
authors: Piveteau V; Dupont C; Salari H; Dumont A; Savocco J; Jost D; Piazza A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母中condensin介导的染色质环挤压及其在DNA双链断裂修复同源搜索中的作用，虽涉及DNA环结构与互作，但非蛋白质-DNA结合位点预测或TF-DNA互作建模，且方法以Hi-C实验为主，无AI或物理模拟建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The in vivo mechanism, cis -acting roadblocks, and biological functions of loop extrusion by eukaryotic SMC complexes are incompletely defined. Here, we identify condensin-dependent Hi-C contact stripes at the Recombination Enhancer ( RE ) and the rDNA in S. cerevisiae . The RE is an autonomous condensin loading site only active in MAT a cells from which oriented, unidirectional loop extrusion proceeds with an estimated processivity ∼150-250 kb and a density ∼0.04-0.18 that varies across the cell cycle. Centromeres, replication forks and highly-transcribed RNA PolII-dependent genes are roadblocks for condensin. Cohesin is not an obstacle for condensin while Top2 promotes its loop extrusion activity. A DNA double-strand break at MAT blocks loop extrusion, resulting in the establishment of a ∼170 kb-long RE - MAT loop. The RE and the DSB are required and sufficient to form this site-specific loop, which promotes RE -proximal homology identification in the early stages of recombinational DNA break repair. We propose that the juxtaposition of the broken MAT a site and its target HML α donor is the relevant structure by which condensin promotes MAT a-to-α switching.
abstract_zh: 真核生物SMC复合物通过环挤压（loop extrusion）的体内机制、顺式作用障碍及其生物学功能尚未完全阐明。在此，我们在酿酒酵母（S. cerevisiae）中鉴定了依赖于凝缩蛋白（condensin）的Hi-C接触条纹，位于重组增强子（Recombination Enhancer, RE）和rDNA处。RE是一个自主的凝缩蛋白装载位点，仅在MAT a细胞中活跃，从该位点进行定向、单向的环挤压，估计持续合成能力约为150-250 kb，密度约为0.04-0.18，且随细胞周期变化。着丝粒、复制叉和高转录的RNA PolII依赖性基因是凝缩蛋白的障碍。黏连蛋白（cohesin）不是凝缩蛋白的障碍，而Top2促进其环挤压活性。MAT处的DNA双链断裂阻断环挤压，导致形成约170 kb长的RE-MAT环。RE和DSB是形成该位点特异性环所必需且充分的，该环促进重组DNA断裂修复早期阶段RE邻近同源性的识别。我们提出，断裂的MAT a位点与其靶标HML α供体的并列是凝缩蛋白促进MAT a-to-α转换的相关结构。
